digest.component_or_area: plan-review Pass-2 verify gate + code-review LLM-Review gate, LLM structured output routing
propositions: Pass-2 prerequisite_verify step fails with HTTP 400 ValidationException after ~185 seconds when plan_review_verification (31 optional parameters) or code_review_verification (36 optional parameters) contracts are sent as native structured output to Bedrock claude-sonnet-4-6, exceeding Anthropic's documented grammar compilation timeout and complexity caps
Every failed verify rejection degrades all findings to no-verification status, producing INDETERMINATE unsigned verdicts with verify_failed=True despite zero blocking findings

The defect is a regression introduced by commit 6c8daf7945 (story 18ae), which set native_structured_output=True for claude-sonnet-4-6 in _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES, overriding the prior _is_claude family rule that kept this model on PromptedOutput mode

The three measured failing contracts all have 22+ optional parameters (every field carries default=, making every field optional in JSON Schema), while passing contracts have ≤14 optionals; the complexity bound must walk the resolved schema recursively through $defs, items, and nested properties to count correctly

Two variant failure modes exist: server-side 180.6-185.9s rejection at Bedrock (Anthropic grammar-compilation timeout), and client-side 0.0s rejection in boto3 when botocore <1.43.64 does not recognize outputConfig parameter, but both block native structured output for these contracts

The fix must gate native selection on (1) whether the stack supports outputConfig, then (2) schema complexity bound of 16 optional / 12 union parameters, downgrading affected contracts to PromptedOutput while preserving native for smaller contracts like review_result (10 optionals) and completion_verdict (14 optionals)
